candidates.description: This feature activates for prominent historical figures, leaders, and key proper nouns from the 20th century and classical history.
This vector activates on common linguistic suffixes and morphological endings found across names and words, particularly in Romance and Germanic languages.
This vector activates on prefixes, roots, and fragments associated with chemical, biological, and political resistance or suppression terms.
This vector activates for German-style proper name prefixes, linguistic syllables, and surname roots beginning with the letters K-a, K-o, and K-u.
This feature vector represents violent destruction, atrocities, and severe conflict.
This vector represents adjectives denoting physical scale, intensity, or magnitude across multiple Romance languages.
This vector represents calendar dates in a month, specifically ranging from the second half through the end.
This vector represents numerical values, specifically hundreds and thousands.
The tokens represent text fragments and words starting with the letters "tr".
This feature vector represents adverbial and nominal suffixes, primarily forming adverbs of manner and action nouns in Romance languages.
